title: Evaluate LLM Answers Against a Golden Set
summary: Implement SQuAD-style answer normalization, exact match and token F1, ROUGE-L via longest common subsequence, a seeded bootstrap confidence interval, and a regression check that compares two model runs example by example.

hints.test_normalize_answer: Order matters: lowercase, strip string.punctuation, then re.sub(r"\b(a|an|the)\b", " ", text), then " ".join(text.split()). The \b boundaries keep 'Anthem' and 'Theory' intact.
hints.test_exact_match: Accept a str or a list of references. Compare normalized strings and take the max over references, returned as a float.
hints.test_token_f1_counts_repeated_tokens_onc: Use Counter(pred) & Counter(gold) and sum the counts. A set intersection undercounts repeated words that appear in both answers.
hints.test_token_f1_matches_reference: precision = overlap / len(pred tokens), recall = overlap / len(gold tokens), F1 = 2PR/(P+R). Return 0.0 when overlap is 0.
hints.test_empty_answers_edge_cases: If either side normalizes to no tokens, F1 is 1.0 only when both are empty. 'the' normalizes to nothing.
hints.test_lcs_and_rouge_l_known_values: Build an (m+1) x (n+1) table and loop i over 1..m and j over 1..n inclusive. The answer is table[m][n].
hints.test_rouge_l_matches_reference: Tokenize with re.findall(r"\w+", text.lower()). precision = lcs/len(candidate), recall = lcs/len(reference), f = 2PR/(P+R).
hints.test_bootstrap_ci_deterministic_and_corr: rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); idx = rng.integers(0, n, size=(n_boot, n)); take np.quantile of the row means at alpha/2 and 1 - alpha/2.
hints.test_evaluate_golden_set: Look up predictions.get(item['id'], '') for each golden item and average the per-example EM and F1. Don't modify the inputs.
hints.test_regression_check: Per-example diff = candidate - baseline. Regressions are negative diffs sorted by (diff, id); improvements are positive diffs sorted by (-diff, id). passed = delta >= -tolerance.
